blocks.heading: Not So Scalable on the Degree Alone
rows: After BSc Zoology

Lab and project assistant posts, B.Ed and school teaching, state and central exams that name the subject, MSc entry. A 2024 Central Silk Board institute project notice, as reported, listed Zoology among accepted BSc subjects, but it was a contract post tied to one project.
One applied skill: fish or bee farming basics, GIS, statistics or a lab method. Plus one field or lab log you can show.
Not so scalable on the degree alone. Scalable with a business layer when you add a farm, lab or teaching business.
After MSc Zoology
Project fellow and research biologist posts at conservation bodies, ZSI and university projects, PGT teaching, NET and JRF entry.
Field survey method, data analysis in R or Python, report writing, and one species or habitat you know deeply.
Not so scalable as a salaried researcher. Scalable with a business layer through consulting, testing or training.
After JRF or PhD
Scientist, faculty and senior research posts, if a post is open. A fellowship is training, not a job.
Papers, a funded project, supervision record and a skill that works outside academia.
Not so scalable. Several filters stack up, so keep an industry or consulting skill running.

blocks.heading: Still a Contract
rows: WII MSc Wildlife Science
About Rs 6,00,000 fee for Indian students; 15 Indian seats; full scholarships for 8 Indian students on merit
Stipend Rs 3,000 a month, subject to funds
3,000 x 24 months = Rs 72,000, which is 12 percent of the fee. A scholarship seat changes the sum completely, so ask for last year's scholarship list.
BNHS Junior Project Fellow (notice 34/2025)
MSc in Wildlife Science, Ecology, Environmental Science, Zoology or related; age up to 30
Rs 25,000 a month, one-year contract, extendable
25,000 x 12 = Rs 3,00,000 a year. The WII fee equals 2.0 years of this pay.
BNHS Project Fellow, Indian Skimmer (notice 09/2026)
MSc in Life Sciences, Zoology, Environmental or Wildlife Science; Hindi needed; extended summer fieldwork
Rs 25,000 a month, one-year professional contract
Same Rs 3,00,000 a year, with long stays away from home.
BNHS Research Biologist, conservation breeding
Higher qualification and experience (read from a search listing, not opened in full)
Rs 55,000 a month, renewable contract
55,000 x 12 = Rs 6,60,000. A senior step, still a contract.
CSIR JRF, then SRF
MSc at 55 percent plus NET; age up to 30
Rs 37,000 a month for two years, then Rs 42,000
37,000 x 12 = Rs 4,44,000; 42,000 x 12 = Rs 5,04,000. A BNHS project fellow earns 68 percent of the JRF figure.
Career-blog ranges for a zoologist
Not stated
Rs 3 to 8 lakh a year, with no source or date
We did not use these. Two of the blogs we read repeat roles and print different ranges for the same job.

blocks.heading: Second Filter in Wildlife and Research
rows: Wildlife scientist
WII MSc Wildlife Science: 20 seats, 15 for Indians, entrance test plus interview in Dehradun (50 percent test, 50 percent interview)
Project posts that run one year at a time, then a few permanent posts in forest, research or institute roles
Each filter is separate. A seat at WII does not carry a job with it.
Forest officer / A degree that names Zoology or another listed subject
IFoS 2026: about 80 vacancies, 1,046 qualified prelims for mains
80 = 13.1 mains candidates per vacancy, after a first filter that already removed most applicants.
Researcher
MSc, then NET or a university test for a funded place
A PhD seat, then a scientist or faculty post
Each stage needs a supervisor, funding and a gap in the right lab.

blocks.heading: Data and Science Writing Ngos, Researchers, Companies
rows: Data and science writing
NGOs, researchers, companies, publishers
A public analysis or a few finished articles
A simple offer: one report type at a clear price, with a sample
Fisheries and aquaculture
Fish farmers, hatcheries, feed and seed firms
Referrals from other farmers, water-test results, a working demo pond
Proof: a before and after record from one farm
Bees, silk, poultry
Households buying a brand, traders, processors, schemes
Lab-tested batches, a traceable source, repeat buyers
Follow-up and referrals; watch one number, repeat orders
Lab and pharma support
Employers; later patients and clinics for a lab you own
Interview, certificates, licences, referrals from doctors
A clear explanation of the method you know
Teaching
School or college; students and parents for tuition
Results, demo classes, word of mouth
Positioning: one exam and one level you teach well
Research
Funding agencies and institutes
Papers, supervisor, project record
Employer-only for now. The sales layer matters for the consulting route after it

figures.label: Global Production Share
figures.source: India is the second-largest fish producer, about 8 percent of world output. Production rose from 96 lakh tonnes in 2013-14 to 195 lakh tonnes in 2024-25, and the sector supports over 30 million livelihoods (PIB, 20 November 2025). Many fisheries posts and the ICAR master's route are written around fisheries degrees, so check whether a zoology MSc qualifies before you plan on a salaried post.

figures.label: Annual Export Value
figures.source: India made about 1.4 lakh tonnes of honey in 2024 and exported about 1.07 lakh tonnes in FY 2023-24 (PIB), under a Rs 500 crore beekeeping mission. Silk supports tens of lakhs of people, though official counts differ by year (80.90 lakh projected up to January 2025, 94.80 lakh for 2023-24). Poultry gave 48.96 percent of meat output in 2023-24, with about 142.77 billion eggs (secondary summary of animal husbandry statistics).
